module: Network message dispatch table of the multiplayer drag mode. The MP gamemode (multiplayer/gamemodes/drag) calls handle(msgName, ...) on every session message received; depending on the name, the module updates the race state in gameplay_drag_core (setRaceState, clearRaceState, setDragRaceData) and emits extensions.hook hooks (onDragRaceStarted, onDragRaceTimerUpdated, onDragRaceTreeLights...). Some messages are only handled by the session host (finishTime, timerUpdateRequest, treeLightUpdate, stateRequest), the others by all clients.
notes: Handled messages: dragSessionStarted, dragRaceStarted, dragRaceCountdownStart, dragRaceStart, dragRacePlayerJoined, dragRaceTreeLights, dragRaceWinningLights, dragRaceTreeLightUpdate (host), dragRaceFinishTime (host), dragRaceTimerUpdate, dragRaceTimerUpdateRequest (host), dragRaceFinishTimeBroadcast, dragRaceReset, dragRaceCancelled, dragRaceRulesUpdate, dragRaceStateRequest (host).

A client's finish time is converted to the host's clock via multiplayer_synclib.mapOtherClock; if the sync is not calibrated or the extension is absent, the raw time is used (warning in the log). Elapsed time = finish (host clock) - syncRaceStart.

The bridge parameter is the gamemode interface (isSessionHost, getRaceState, getTimerRecipientMPClientIds, sendToMPClientIds, getLocalMPPlayerId...); state contains dragRaces and localClientActiveRace.
dragRaceRulesUpdate saves the rules locally via multiplayer.gamemodes.drag.util.presetManager (pcall) and updates dragType, treeType and importantTimerId of dragData.
The parameters senderId, recpIds, packetClock, recvClock, msgNumber of handle are not used.

handle.desc: Entry point: looks up the handler for the message msgName and calls it with (state, bridge, client, senderId, recpIds, data). Unknown messages are ignored without error.

bridge.desc: MP gamemode interface (session, network, race state).

data.desc: Message payload (type, raceId, lane, lightState, timerName, timerValue...).
